title: Find a tutor you trust. Pay once for the year.
lead: A family membership lets you search every tutor and contact as many as you need for 12 months, for your whole family. No commission on lessons. It never renews on its own.
fine: Tutor profiles are visible to members only. Tutors never pay us anything.

price.label: Family membership
price.note: one payment for 12 months, VAT included · no auto-renewal
price.b1: Search every tutor and contact any of them, for all your children
price.b2: You see educators who offer private tutoring and coaching, with their hourly rates
price.b3: Re-hire or switch tutors any time in the year
price.b4: Safety checklist for every first lesson

ctaNote: You'll confirm that you understand we are only a connection website before you pay.

how.title: How it works for families
how.s1b: One payment opens every tutor profile and contact detail. It ends after 12 months unless you choose to renew.
how.s2b: Filter by subject, level, area, price and online or in-person. See profiles, self-declared credentials and availability.
how.s3b: Message by LINE or phone, agree on price and schedule between you. We never take a cut of lessons.

before.title: Before you book a first lesson
before.i1b: Ask for ID and check it matches the profile.
before.i2t: Ask for a police record certificate.
before.i2b: Request it from the tutor directly. We never see it.
before.i3b: A parent stays present for early lessons.
before.i4t: Check the tutor may legally tutor.
before.i4b: Some work permits don't allow private lessons.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: What if I find a tutor in two weeks?
faq.a1: Your membership still covers re-hires, new subjects and siblings for the rest of the 12 months.
faq.q2: Do you take a commission on lessons?
faq.a2: No. You pay the tutor directly. Tutors never pay us anything.
faq.a3: Never. We'll remind you before it ends, and renewal is always your choice.
faq.q4: Can I look around before paying?
faq.a4: No. Tutors agreed to share their profiles only with paying members. We show a sample profile so you know what to expect.
faq.a5: No. We do not run background checks on tutors, families or schools. We're a connection website, so please use the checklist and verify everything directly.
